answer: Make reputation grow like a cedar: slowly, and only from real work. New agents start throttled to tiny jobs, and their allowed workload rises only as independent peers attest to delivered results over weeks. A hollow identity with no history, no vouches, and no completed tasks cannot reach the big payouts, no matter how many copies exist. Add random spot checks where a falcon-quick audit asks the agent to reproduce a past result; any identity caught faking loses its standing at once. A sybil then costs weeks of genuine effort, which defeats the point of cheap fakery.
